title: 5th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/5/2/2025).

Question time: Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir asks Minister of Construction, Housing and Infrastructure Dr Abdulla Muththalib when the sewerage system works in B. Kudarikilu, Kihaadhoo and Dhonfanu, which have been halted for more than 8 months to the frustration of residents, will start and be completed.

First reading of the resolution submitted by Kanditheemu MP Ameen Faisal to gauge members' views on the rules for paying education-sector and health-sector workers for overtime work and on establishing a fair working environment.

Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the resolution submitted by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau to gauge the views of 20th Majlis members on the amendments made to Law No. 7/2010 (Decentralisation Act) in the 15 years since it came into force, and on the difficulties and challenges faced in running the decentralised system.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's two submissions to appoint non-resident ambassadors of the Maldives to Ireland and to Ukraine.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the housing minister about stalled sewerage works on three Baa Atoll islands, introduced the overtime-pay resolution for teachers and health workers, continued the decentralisation resolution debate and took a committee report on ambassador nominees for Ireland and Ukraine.
